site.name: Moffatt Township
site.sealAlt: Moffatt Township, Arenac County, Michigan official seal
site.heroText: A northern Michigan rural community in Arenac County. Find meetings, permits, ordinances, rentals and township services here.
site.mailing: Moffatt Township, PO Box 58, Alger, MI 48610
site.hallDirections: Just north of Maple Ridge Road.
site.hoursNote: The township hall has no regular office hours. Please call or email the appropriate official to reach us.
site.parkAddress: 1611 Henry St (between Newberry and Maple Ridge Road)
site.parkNote: The park is not available from Nov 1 to April 30.
site.rentalsNote: Review the rental agreement, email to confirm availability, then mail the completed form with payment to: Moffatt Township, Attention: Rentals, PO Box 58, Alger, MI 48610.

tiles.title: Permits

tiles.title: Hall & Park Rentals
tiles.desc: Reserve the hall or park pavilion.

announcements.title: New zoning complaint procedure
announcements.body: Zoning complaints now require the official complaint form.

announcements.title: Burn regulations
announcements.body: Burn permits and regulations are handled through the Michigan DNR.

meetings.name: Township Board
meetings.schedule: 6:30 PM, 3rd Monday of the month, March through December. 6:30 PM on the Tuesday after the third Monday, January through February.
meetings.location: Moffatt Township Hall, 1590 N M-76, Alger, MI 48610

meetings.name: Planning Commission
meetings.schedule: 6:00 PM, second Thursday monthly, February through November (varies per calendar).

meetings.name: Fire Department
meetings.schedule: Business meetings: last Wednesday monthly at 7:00 PM. Training: second Wednesday monthly at 7:00 PM.

meetings.name: Board of Review
meetings.schedule: Held in March. You will be notified by mail regarding your valuation.

meetings.name: Arenac County Road Commission
meetings.schedule: 10:00 AM, 1st and 3rd Mondays of each month.

accessibility.statement: Moffatt Township is committed to making this website accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA, which also covers WCAG 2.1 AA. If you find a barrier on this site, or need information in another format, please contact the person listed below and we will respond promptly.
